subject: Copywriting
title: Seth Godin: Permission Marketing
description: A quick win: understand Seth Godin: Permission Marketing.

hook.text: Seth Godin said interruption marketing is dead. You can't shout louder than the internet. You need permission first.

buildup.text: His 1999 book 'Permission Marketing' predicted the email newsletter boom. Build an audience that wants to hear from you.

discovery.text: Godin's daily blog, running since 2002, proved his own concept. Millions subscribed. He never sent a single spam email.

twist.text: He doesn't do social media. No Twitter, no Instagram. His blog and email list outperform brands spending millions.

climax.text: Godin shifted copywriting from 'how do I interrupt?' to 'how do I earn attention?' A fundamental reframe.

punchline.text: Earn attention. Don't steal it. Permission marketing wins.

quiz.question: What did Seth Godin predict would replace interruption marketing?
options: Permission marketing via email and trust
